api_contract.time_struct_from_in: struct ds3231_time drv; drv.seconds = ((in->second / 10) << 4) | (in->second % 10); drv.minutes = ((in->minute / 10) << 4) | (in->minute % 10); drv.hours = ((in->hour / 10) << 4) | (in->hour % 10); drv.day = in->weekday; drv.date = ((in->day / 10) << 4) | (in->day % 10); drv.month = ((in->month / 10) << 4) | (in->month % 10); drv.year = ((in->year % 100 / 10) << 4) | (in->year % 10);
